question: An engineer needs to connect Cisco UCS Fabric Interconnect (FI) to an external storage array. Due to budget limitations, the engineer must connect a Cisco UCS FI directly to an FC storage port. Which two actions must be taken to complete this connection? (Choose two.)
options: Configure the fabric interconnect in end-host mode.
Create the required VSAN in the SAN cloud.
Set FC zoning to disabled when creating the VSAN.
Configure the fabric interconnect in FC switch mode.
